headline: Revenue grows, EPS slips on UK VAT charge and FX headwinds
summary_short: Align Technology posted Q2 2026 revenue of $1,056.2 million (+4.3% y/y) but GAAP diluted EPS fell to $1.51, down 12.2% y/y, weighed down by a $37.5 million UK VAT liability and unfavorable foreign exchange; non-GAAP EPS was $2.64.
summary_long: Q2'26 revenue rose 4.3% y/y to $1,056.2 million as 8.2% Clear Aligner growth offset a 10.8% decline in Systems and Services. GAAP gross margin held near flat at 71.7%; GAAP operating margin fell to 14.6% (from 16.1%) after a $37.5 million UK VAT liability and unfavorable FX. GAAP diluted EPS fell 12.2% y/y to $1.51 (non-GAAP $2.64, +6.0% y/y). Cash rose to $1,102.6 million from $1,059.8 million at Q1-end; the company repurchased $67.0 million of stock. Align reaffirmed FY2026 revenue growth (3-4%) and non-GAAP operating margin (~23.7%) guidance, while giving Q3'26 revenue guidance of $1,000-1,020 million, below Q2 levels.
